thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT OPENED — P1 | Elevated 5xx rate in ap-southeast1 gateway (detected 03:00 UTC). Auto-paged on-call. Pager: laura.

laura (oncall): saw it, joining. seeing 502/504 spikes across gateway nodes, latency up ~x3.

emily: confirming from observability — error budget burn for hosted-api in ap-southeast1. 5xx rate spike started ~02:55 UTC.

ashish: is this originating from frontend (edge) or service? I see spike in gateway+worker pool.

laura (oncall): quick triage: curl to regional gateway returns 502 intermittently. From my laptop: `curl -I https://api.ap-southeast1.redwood.ai/health` sometimes 200, sometimes 502.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: No active deploys recorded in last 30m for ap-southeast1.

laura (oncall): running `kubectl get pods -n redwood-gateway -o wide` — some gateway pods show `CrashLoopBackOff`? attaching output: ```
NAME                                      READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE   IP
gateway-0                                 2/2     Running            0          6d   10.4.1.12
gateway-1                                 1/2     CrashLoopBackOff   6          2d   10.4.1.13
gateway-2                                 2/2     Running            0          6d   10.4.1.14
```

jordan-cs: we have 3 customers reporting increased error rates in APAC. CS tier: high. Please keep me posted.

laura (oncall): checking pod logs for gateway-1: ```
E0303 02:58:11.123 gateway.go:245] upstream connection failed: EOF
E0303 02:58:11.124 proxy.go:87] 502 from upstream, target=svc-backend:grpc
```

emily: backend services (model router) in same region show some elevated CPU and gRPC timeouts from router->worker. Could be hotspots causing connection resets.

ashish: rolling restart suggestion? If gateway pod is crashing due to upstream resets maybe warmup/debug. We should also divert traffic to eu-west1 as temporary fallback.

laura (oncall): starting incident bridge. On-call handoff: @sre-rotation can you join for followups?

sre-rotation: joining. summary pls.

laura (oncall): summary: APAC gateway high 5xx, some gateway pods CrashLoopBackOff due to upstream EOFs. Customer impact: generation requests failing intermittently, ~40% error rate for a subset of routes. Mitigation plan: 1) scale gateway replicas in ap-southeast1; 2) divert non-low-latency traffic to eu-west1; 3) investigate worker pool health.

ops-bot: Runbook link: <https://redwood-infra.example.com/runbooks/gateway-5xx>

ashish: scaling gateway now: `kubectl scale deployment/gateway --replicas=5 -n redwood-gateway` — scaling triggered.

laura (oncall): increasing model-router pool? we have autoscaling but it's not keeping up. Doing `kubectl scale deployment/model-router --replicas=8 -n redwood-core`.

emily: added CPU requests on a few pods to reduce OOM churn temporarily. Observability: overall 5xx rate dropped from 42% -> 28% after scales but still above baseline (~2%).

jordan-cs: any ETA for full recovery? customers asking.

laura (oncall): ETA unknown. continuing mitigation. I'm going to open cross-region fallback for non-SLA customers: update routing policy to prefer eu-west1 for region=ap-southeast1 if latency SLA < 200ms not required.

incident-bot: ACTION: Rolling route rollout initiated by laura — routing policy change id rtp-20260303-01.

laura (oncall): applying routing override: `redwoodctl route update --region ap-southeast1 --fallback eu-west1 --selectors "!sla=low-latency" --percentage 50` — pushing 50% to eu-west1 first.

ops-bot: Routing change accepted, gradual shift starts now.

emily: metrics after 10m: region 5xx rate in APAC down to 18% as some traffic diverted. eu-west1 latency increase 12ms but error rate stable.

ashish: still seeing gateway-1 CrashLoopBackOff restarts persist. digging into container crash reason — looks like outbound connection pool exhaustion: `too many open files` in kernel logs. Might be high file descriptor usage after a misbehaving client.

laura (oncall): temporary mitigation: rotate gateway pods to clear FDs. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway -n redwood-gateway` done.

emily: after restart, gateway pod statuses returned to 2/2. 5xx rate dropped to 6% in APAC. Great.

jordan-cs: customers reporting improvement. Thank you.

laura (oncall): keeping incident open to monitor for 30m. We'll keep routing override in place until next maintenance window. Need post-incident action: tune FD limits and add guardrails for client connections.

sre-rotation: logging follow-up items: (1) review ulimit / fd settings on gateway images, (2) add metric for ephemeral fd exhaustion, (3) test routing fallback automation to ensure can be triggered faster.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — severity downgraded to P2, status: mitigated (partial) at 03:45 UTC.

laura (oncall): drafting incident summary for postmortem. Will include timeline, mitigations, customer impact, and action items. tagging emily & ashish for root cause analysis.

emily: saving logs and dashboards snapshot: <https://observability.redwood.ai/snapshots/abc123>

ashish: I'll run a deeper replay of connection graphs and look for client patterns that drove FD exhaustion.

jordan-cs: I will send a customer-facing note for affected accounts in APAC explaining mitigation and that we're doing RCA.

laura (oncall): thanks team. I'll keep the bridge open for 30m, then will move to postmortem channel. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident will auto-close in 7 days unless marked resolved.
